name: Local AI Server
author: SYJohnm
description: Run a local llama.cpp or ollama server from the bar: any llama.cpp build or fork (picked per model), live prompt/generation speed, per-model tuning, and the prompt cache kept across restarts.

barWidget.description: Run a local llama.cpp or ollama server from the bar: any llama.cpp build or fork (picked per model), live prompt/generation speed, per-model tuning, and the prompt cache kept across restarts.

schema.label: Backend
schema.description: Which local server to manage. Can also be switched from the panel.

options.label: ollama
options.description: ollama serve; throughput per completed request

schema.label: Preferred llama-server binary
schema.description: Optional. Every llama.cpp build on the machine is detected (upstream, distro package, forks under ~); this one is preferred when a model is on Auto.

schema.label: Extra llama-server binary
schema.description: Optional. A build the scan does not find on its own (installed somewhere unusual). It joins the Build list on the Model tab.

schema.label: Models directory
schema.description: Leave blank to auto-detect (~/models, ~/.cache/llama.cpp, LM Studio, jan).
